instruction: Assam ki rajdhani kya hai?
output: Assam ki rajdhani Dispur hai, jo Guwahati ke andar sthit hai.

instruction: Assam Bharat ke kis hisse mein sthit hai?
output: Assam Bharat ke Northeast India yani Purvottar Bharat mein sthit ek rajya hai.

instruction: Assam ki official language kya hai?
output: Assam ki mukhya rajbhasha Assamese hai. Rajya ke alag-alag kshetron mein Bengali, Bodo aur anya bhashayein bhi boli jaati hain.

instruction: Assam ka sabse bada shahar kaunsa hai?
output: Guwahati Assam ka sabse bada aur pramukh shahar hai.

instruction: Assam kis cheez ke liye famous hai?
output: Assam apne tea gardens, Kaziranga National Park, one-horned rhinoceros, Brahmaputra River, Bihu festival, silk aur rich wildlife ke liye famous hai.

instruction: Assam mein Bihu kya hai?
output: Bihu Assam ka sabse pramukh festival hai. Iske teen mukhya roop hain Rongali Bihu, Kongali Bihu aur Bhogali Bihu.

instruction: Rongali Bihu kya hai?
output: Rongali Bihu, jise Bohag Bihu bhi kaha jata hai, Assam ka spring aur agricultural new year festival hai. Yeh aam taur par April mein manaya jata hai.

instruction: Bhogali Bihu kya hai?
output: Bhogali Bihu, jise Magh Bihu bhi kaha jata hai, harvest festival hai. Ismein traditional food, community celebrations aur meji jalane ki parampara hoti hai.

instruction: Kongali Bihu kya hai?
output: Kongali Bihu, jise Kati Bihu bhi kaha jata hai, kheti ke dauran manaya jane wala festival hai. Ismein fasal ki achhi growth ke liye prarthana ki jaati hai.

instruction: Kaziranga National Park kahan hai?
output: Kaziranga National Park Assam mein Brahmaputra River ke floodplain area mein sthit hai. Yeh Indian one-horned rhinoceros ke liye duniya bhar mein famous hai.

instruction: Kaziranga kis janwar ke liye famous hai?
output: Kaziranga National Park Indian one-horned rhinoceros ke liye sabse zyada famous hai. Yahan elephant, tiger, wild water buffalo aur swamp deer jaise wildlife bhi milte hain.

instruction: Majuli kya hai?
output: Majuli Assam mein Brahmaputra River par sthit ek bada river island hai. Yeh Assamese culture, Vaishnavite monasteries yani Satras aur traditional arts ke liye famous hai.

instruction: Majuli kis cheez ke liye famous hai?
output: Majuli apni Assamese Vaishnavite culture, Satras, traditional mask-making, dance, music aur scenic river landscape ke liye famous hai.

instruction: Assam ki sabse important river kaunsi hai?
output: Brahmaputra Assam ki sabse important aur prominent river hai. Yeh rajya ke geography, agriculture, culture aur economy mein bahut important role nibhati hai.

instruction: Assam mein tea industry kyun famous hai?
output: Assam duniya ke famous tea-producing regions mein se ek hai. Assam tea apne strong taste, rich colour aur distinctive aroma ke liye jaani jaati hai.

instruction: Assam tea kya hai?
output: Assam tea Assam mein ugayi jane wali tea hai jo Camellia sinensis var. assamica plant se produce hoti hai. Iska flavour strong aur malty hota hai.

instruction: Assam ka state animal kya hai?
output: Assam ka state animal Indian one-horned rhinoceros hai.

instruction: Assam ka state bird kya hai?
output: Assam ka state bird White-winged Wood Duck hai, jise Assamese mein Deo Haah ke naam se bhi jaana jata hai.

instruction: Assam ka state flower kya hai?
output: Assam ka state flower Foxtail Orchid hai, jise Kopou Phool bhi kaha jata hai.

instruction: Assam ka state tree kya hai?
output: Assam ka state tree Hollong hai.

instruction: Assam ka traditional dress kya hai?
output: Assam ke traditional clothing mein women ke liye Mekhela Chador aur men ke liye Dhoti, Kurta aur traditional Gamosa jaise garments important hain.

instruction: Gamosa kya hai?
output: Gamosa Assam ka ek traditional handwoven cloth hai. Yeh Assamese identity aur culture ka important symbol hai aur Bihu celebrations mein bhi iska use hota hai.

instruction: Mekhela Chador kya hai?
output: Mekhela Chador Assam ki traditional women's attire hai. Yeh aam taur par do main pieces se milkar banti hai aur traditional Assamese weaving se bhi jodi jaati hai.

instruction: Assam ke famous silk kaun se hain?
output: Assam Muga Silk, Eri Silk aur Pat Silk ke liye famous hai. Muga Silk apni natural golden colour aur durability ke liye particularly famous hai.

instruction: Muga silk kya hai?
output: Muga silk Assam ka traditional golden-coloured silk hai. Yeh apni natural shine, durability aur Assamese cultural importance ke liye famous hai.

instruction: Sualkuchi kya hai?
output: Sualkuchi Assam ka famous weaving town hai, jo silk production aur traditional Assamese textiles ke liye jaana jata hai. Yeh Brahmaputra ke north bank par sthit hai.

instruction: Assam ke famous historical places kaun se hain?
output: Assam ke important historical places mein Sivasagar ke Ahom-era monuments, Rang Ghar, Talatal Ghar, Kareng Ghar aur Charaideo ke Maidams shamil hain.

instruction: Rang Ghar kya hai?
output: Rang Ghar Sivasagar ke paas sthit ek historic Ahom-era amphitheatre hai. Ise Ahom kings ke samay entertainment aur traditional sports dekhne ke liye use kiya jata tha.

instruction: Talatal Ghar kya hai?
output: Talatal Ghar Sivasagar mein sthit Ahom-era ka ek important historical monument hai. Yeh Ahom architecture aur military history ke liye famous hai.

instruction: Charaideo Maidams kya hain?
output: Charaideo Maidams Ahom royalty ke burial mounds hain. Charaideo ko Ahom dynasty ka sacred burial centre maana jata hai.

instruction: Assam ki economy mein agriculture ka kya role hai?
output: Agriculture Assam ki economy ka important hissa hai. Rice, tea, vegetables, sugarcane aur various horticultural crops rajya mein produce kiye jaate hain.

instruction: Assam mein kaun si main crop ugayi jaati hai?
output: Rice Assam ki major food crop hai. Iske alawa tea, jute, sugarcane, mustard aur various fruits aur vegetables bhi ugaye jaate hain.

instruction: Assam ka famous national park kaunsa hai?
output: Kaziranga National Park Assam ka sabse famous national parks mein se ek hai. Iske alawa Manas National Park, Nameri National Park aur Orang National Park bhi important hain.

instruction: Manas National Park kahan hai?
output: Manas National Park Assam ke western part mein Bhutan border ke paas sthit hai. Yeh wildlife, forests aur biodiversity ke liye famous hai.

instruction: Assam mein kaun-kaun se national parks hain?
output: Assam mein Kaziranga, Manas, Nameri, Orang aur Dibru-Saikhowa jaise important national parks aur protected areas hain.

instruction: Assam ka wildlife kisliye famous hai?
output: Assam apni rich biodiversity ke liye famous hai. Yahan one-horned rhinoceros, tiger, elephant, wild water buffalo, hoolock gibbon aur kai rare bird species milti hain.

instruction: Hoolock gibbon kya hai?
output: Hoolock gibbon India ka ekmatra ape hai aur Assam ke forests mein paya jata hai. Yeh apni distinctive calls aur tree-dwelling lifestyle ke liye jaana jata hai.

instruction: Assam ka traditional food kya hai?
output: Assamese cuisine mein rice, dal, vegetables, fish, tenga, khar aur pitika jaise traditional dishes important hain. Assamese food generally fresh aur locally available ingredients par based hota hai.

instruction: Khar kya hai?
output: Khar ek traditional Assamese preparation hai jo alkaline ingredient se banayi jaati hai. Yeh Assamese cuisine ka distinctive aur traditional dish hai.

instruction: Masor Tenga kya hai?
output: Masor Tenga ek traditional Assamese fish curry hai jiska taste light aur tangy hota hai. Ismein fish ke saath souring ingredients ka use kiya jata hai.

instruction: Assam mein kaun si river island famous hai?
output: Majuli Assam ki sabse famous river islands mein se ek hai aur Brahmaputra River ke cultural landscape ka important part hai.

instruction: Assam ka climate kaisa hai?
output: Assam ka climate generally humid subtropical hai. Rajya mein monsoon ke dauran heavy rainfall hoti hai aur Brahmaputra valley mein baarish ka important role hai.

instruction: Assam mein flood kyun aata hai?
output: Assam mein floods ka major reason Brahmaputra aur uski tributaries mein heavy monsoon rainfall, high river discharge, silt deposition aur low-lying floodplains hain.

instruction: Assam ki famous cultural dance kaunsi hai?
output: Bihu dance Assam ki sabse famous traditional dances mein se ek hai. Yeh especially Bohag Bihu ke celebrations ke dauran perform kiya jata hai.

instruction: Sattriya kya hai?
output: Sattriya Assam ki classical dance tradition hai jo Vaishnavite Satras se develop hui. Iska sambandh Srimanta Sankardeva ki Neo-Vaishnavite tradition se hai.

instruction: Srimanta Sankardeva kaun the?
output: Srimanta Sankardeva Assam ke महान saint, poet, playwright aur social-religious reformer the. Unhone Assam mein Neo-Vaishnavite movement ko develop aur popularize kiya.

instruction: Assamese culture mein Satras kya hain?
output: Satras Assam ke Vaishnavite monasteries aur cultural institutions hain. Inka sambandh Srimanta Sankardeva aur unki Neo-Vaishnavite tradition se hai.

instruction: Assam ka famous pilgrimage place kaunsa hai?
output: Kamakhya Temple Guwahati ke Nilachal Hill par sthit Assam ka ek important Hindu pilgrimage site hai.

instruction: Kamakhya Temple kahan hai?
output: Kamakhya Temple Guwahati, Assam ke Nilachal Hill par sthit hai. Yeh Shakti worship ka ek important pilgrimage centre hai.

instruction: Assam ke famous tourist places kaun se hain?
output: Assam ke popular tourist destinations mein Kaziranga, Majuli, Sivasagar, Guwahati, Kamakhya Temple, Manas National Park, Haflong aur Pobitora Wildlife Sanctuary shamil hain.

instruction: Guwahati kis river ke kinare hai?
output: Guwahati Brahmaputra River ke southern bank par sthit Assam ka major city hai.

instruction: Assam mein one-horned rhinoceros ko kahan dekha ja sakta hai?
output: One-horned rhinoceros ko Assam ke Kaziranga National Park, Pobitora Wildlife Sanctuary aur kuch anya protected areas mein dekha ja sakta hai.
